neighbours.label: the compared quality or marker in a negated or contrastive comparison (not as flashy as, 不像…一样, wasn't X like Y)
fire: Turnips are not as glamorous as shrimp, but they grow anywhere.
This film is certainly not as famous as his earlier work.
The new phone is not as fast as the one I had before.
Our village isn't nearly as crowded as the capital.
His second novel was not as well received as his first.
The lake is not as deep as people used to say.
The hotel was not quite as comfortable as the brochure promised.
My sister is not as patient as our mother.
quiet: Turnips are cheap and easy, and they grow almost anywhere.
This film is certainly one of his most famous works.
The new phone is very fast and has a large screen.
Our village is quiet and has only one shop.
His second novel was well received by most critics.
The lake is deep and very cold in the spring.
The hotel was comfortable and close to the beach.
My sister is patient and very kind to children.

notes: card only; top examples are 'not as X as' and Chinese 不像…一样/那样; output suppresses like/unlike/compared
